rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of QILIN. The QI of Shuowen quoted by Kangxi: benevolent deer-bodied ox-tailed beast with exactly ONE horn, not Guo Pu's hornless version.
ANATOMY: ONE living quadruped with a roe-deer-like body, ONE head, TWO eyes, FOUR natural hoofed legs, ONE unmistakable long OX tail ending in a dense bovine tuft, and exactly ONE solid straight central forehead HORN. No antlers, paired horns, wolf forehead, lion mane, dragon scales, five-colour requirement, wings, fire or armour. This is specifically the Shuowen QI one-horn description in c10, NOT Guo Pu's separate hornless interpretation. Natural dark warm brown fur; palette artistic. [qilin-c10]
MOMENT: Leap diagonally upward toward the foreground across the rough natural ground, front legs lifted distinctly, rear hooves pushing off, tail sweeping fully across one side. Turn the proud head toward us with an intense wise gaze, single horn fully silhouetted.
POWER: No supernatural power effect, no flame or elemental control. Sacred overwhelming presence comes from the exact composite anatomy and dynamic approach of the benevolent beast. Physically scattered earth from the leap is small and plausible. [qilin-c10]
SCALE & CAMERA: Full-body broad diagonal low-angle composition, beast occupies eighty-five percent of square with ALL FOUR legs, OX tail and ONE central horn readable. Ordinary body size through near-camera framing, not invented cosmic giant.
LIGHT & WEATHER: One strong dying-sun sidelight, rich dark walnut and antique gold accents in the natural fur and hoof texture.
SURFACE: Tactile natural fur, fish/serpent scales, hoof, feathers or stone as specified; premium traditional painterly brushwork, never glossy plastic or a toy.
SETTING: Tight natural dark earth-and-rock background as neutral editorial staging; no invented temple, palace, ritual or named habitat claim.
MOOD: overwhelming and imposing sacred presence; respectful, benevolent when source says so, energetic and majestic, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: one square original illustration; no text, labels, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra limbs, heads, tails or digits beyond exact counts above; no nudity or gore; no design from a film, game, anime or comic; no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons, floating runes or unsupported supernatural effects. Identifying anatomical components all readable at thumbnail size.

A setting uses recorded Daye hunt c12 as natural terrain backdrop, no reenacted capture. B has neutral editorial natural terrain without claiming a specific sourced habitat.
Documented stature c07 underlies A; B dominance comes from close low-angle framing, without claiming cosmic or giant size. Physical dust is ordinary hoof impact.

B selected because the exactly ONE central horn of the explicit Shuowen QI variant is unmistakable at thumbnail and full-body leap displays ox-tail/deer body.
